idRules.rule: No grade, label text, source-system name or revision in identity. Reuse shared concepts through declared typed references.
Identity is a term sense, not just a printed word.
Identity includes interpretation scope; the same glyph can have different meanings.
Do not encode mutable relationType or revision in ID; preserve ID when revising an assertion.
Official band and inferred year are separate fields.
Use a local wrapper with boundaryEvidenceIds; never redefine an official EvidenceLocator ID.

deliverables.requirement: One domain workpack covering both official grade bands; no prescribed concept count.

Each concept has a precise definition, conditions, separate term senses, meaningful notation when applicable, a worked example and misconceptions; university-level structural explanations remain optional lenses, not student prerequisites.
Each standard alignment cites official boundary evidence. Mathematics and teaching-order reasoning identify author reasoning separately.
Candidate dependencies have rationale, perspective and conditions. Use required only within an explicit explanatory route; keep helpful, related and representation separate.
Each assigned standard gets a coherent CoverageClaim. Use partial/not_started and ContentGap rather than falsely marking incomplete content mapped_draft.
Declare cross-domain prerequisites as typed ExternalReferences; parent resolves them in integrated corpus. Do not fabricate missing records.

authoringPolicies.rule: Use EvidenceReference.sourceType=author_model for model-generated reasoning and keep official_curriculum wrappers distinct. Reuse workflowStatus/evidenceStatus, rationale/reasoning, and revision rather than adding duplicate provenance fields.

For MathNotation rendering, use registered math:extension:latex with MathMarkup.source containing literal LaTeX and plainTextFallback. Preserve JSON backslashes; do not globally sanitize LaTeX source.
Use workflowStatus=draft or under_review. The v1 validator rejects approved/applied claims because it cannot authenticate human decisions.
yearPlacement=null and placementBasis=not_assigned by default. Do not infer exact years from 6수 or 9수. If a year is inferred, label author_inference and attach evidence.
Only one workpack owns any stable ID. Shared core Perspective is math:perspective:structural-adult from workpacks/core.json.
Conditions are human-reviewed statements. All machineCheckable fields remain false; DAG validation conservatively combines selected DAG-policy relations within each perspective.
Spatial position, open panels, filters and focus are view state; they do not silently edit semantic assertions.

validationCommands.interpretation: Errors must be fixed. Unresolved cross-workpack references and uncovered assigned standards remain explicit warnings during drafting.
Requires resolved references and active direct structural coverage in declared scope; this does not certify pedagogy or mathematical truth.

validationCommands.command: python validate_workpack.py workpacks/domain-01.json workpacks/domain-02.json workpacks/domain-03.json workpacks/domain-04.json --boundary <curriculum-boundary.json> --context workpacks/core.json --full-curriculum
validationCommands.interpretation: Requires all official domains and both grade bands from domain_content packs; no fixed 75-object prototype assumption.

extensionWorkflow.action: Propose a new field/relation/action/type with purpose, applicable kinds, value schema and example.
Add a versioned registry entry and, for new core kinds or fields, a matching schema revision. Unknown extensions are rejected.
Run valid and invalid fixtures; provide UI adapter handling or explicit unsupported-state behavior.
Preserve old artifact bytes and stable IDs. Record a migration plan and validate new revision before replacing a consumer binding.

prototypePolicy.importPolicy: Do not bulk relabel demo data as production. Reconcile IDs and evidence explicitly.
